title: Organic & Inorganic Compounds
notes:
Organic vs Inorganic Chemistry

Organic Compounds: Hydrocarbons and derivatives from living sources (disproved 'Vital Force' theory by Wöhler in 1828 with urea synthesis).
Inorganic Compounds: Mineral-derived compounds from all elements in periodic table.
summary: Organic hydrocarbons vs inorganic mineral compounds.
